outline:
本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，由各專業管理領域老師分別教授。可以讓學生結合理論與實務，發掘、陳述、分析個案並解決相關管理問題，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊的互動與學習。
The course is conducted in the Harvard case teaching method. In each case discussion, teachers from various professional management fields are taught separately. Students can combine theory and practice to discover, present, analyze and solve related management problems. At the end of the semester, there are group case competitions to promote team interaction and learning.
